title: r2c.adapter-map/v1
description: Payload-to-agent placement map (`adapters/<agent>/map.json`). Every entry is one action; `{project}`, `{user}`, `{stem}` and `{dir}` are expanded by src/adapter/plan.js. A different schema is ADAPTER_MAP_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED (exit 2).

from.description: Payload-relative source glob/path, or --mcp for the optional MCP merge.

to.description: Target template under the scope root.

pointers.description: merge-json only: dotted pointers that own our keys.

optional.description: Entry applies only when the named option was supplied.

enabledBy.description: derive-agent only: adapter capability path that must be truthy.
